summary: Recent UNP highlights: Union Pacific and Norfolk Southern filed an amended merger application on April 30, 2026, projecting $3.5B annual shipper savings. UNP will exit if STB orders widespread line sales or trackage rights. Q1 earnings beat: profit $1.70B / $2.87 EPS on revenue of $6.22B. Operational metrics: freight car velocity +9% to 235 daily miles per car; terminal dwell improved 11% to 19.7 hours. Stock rallied to 52-week high after earnings. Per 23 analysts, average rating Buy with 12-month PT $275.55.
